body.x: PATCHWORKS (patchworksonline.com), specializing in manufacturing protective glass products for smartphones, announced the release of "ITG PRO PULS" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.ITG PRO PULS has a hardness of 9H, three times stronger than regular PET film. Even sharp objects such as knives and keys will not scratch the protector. Extra polished beveled edge design provides stronger edge impact protection. Also, finger swipes across the display works through the protector.
